_note: Hand-annotated by the orchestrator (2026-10-08) from v2/out/sheets/wd2_<stem>.png: pelvis-relative z and forward velocity per effector + stick figures. Times in seconds of the WD2 clip. 'hands_on' = surface the hands touch ('top' = obstacle top, 'ground' = ground beyond the obstacle). Accuracy about +-0.05 s.

catpass_kong.comment: Hands go 0.5 m below the pelvis while planted (body passes over them). Takeoff->landing 0.65 s, close to ACU SkipOver Fd100-Up100 (0.68 s).

diveroll_frontdive.comment: Dive: feet go ~0.75 m ABOVE the pelvis (inverted) at 0.8-1.05 s, hands land on the ground beyond the obstacle, forward roll, feet down at 1.2 s, run-out from ~1.6 s. Takeoff->feet down 0.75 s.
